descriptionChirho: Masculine noun מַנְעוּל referring to a lock, bolt, or bar used to secure a door or gate. In Nehemiah (3:3,6,13,14,15) it appears in the plural construct with possessive suffix ('its locks') describing the restoration of Jerusalem's gates with their locking mechanisms. In Song of Songs 5:5 it appears as a singular 'the bolt' of a door. Multilingual evidence: eng locks/bolt, spa cerraduras/cerradura, hin ताले, arb أَقْفَال/مَنْعُول, kor 자물쇠/빗장, swa makomeo/komeo. The singular/plural and suffixed/articled variation is morphological, not semantic.
